meta.title: Your Credit Card Rewards Aren't Free
meta.hook: Your credit card points are paid for by a hidden money loop.
meta.description: Rewards cards are funded by an issuer's broader economics: merchant interchange, annual fees, and interest from revolving balances. Paying in full can avoid interest, but the merchant still pays to accept the card. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Your credit card points are paid for by a hidden money loop, not by a bank's generosity.

visual.visual_intent: A credit card tapping a payment terminal in tight macro focus
visual.decision_reason: Federal Reserve research explains issuer interchange income and rewards costs

scenes.narration: When you tap the card, the merchant pays processing charges, including interchange that flows toward the issuing bank.

visual.visual_intent: A merchant watching a card transaction clear at a busy counter
visual.decision_reason: Merchant-to-issuer interchange mechanism documented by Federal Reserve

scenes.narration: That issuer also earns annual fees on some cards, plus interest and other fees from customers carrying balances.

visual.visual_intent: A statement with interest and annual-fee lines highlighted
visual.decision_reason: Federal Reserve paper treats interest and fees as issuer income

scenes.narration: Rewards are an expense inside that larger business model. Different customers generate very different revenue and cost profiles.

visual.visual_intent: Reward points accumulating on a phone screen
visual.decision_reason: Federal Reserve paper treats rewards as a bank cost

scenes.narration: Paying the statement balance in full can avoid purchase interest, but the merchant-side payment still happened at checkout.

visual.visual_intent: A cardholder paying a full statement balance online
visual.decision_reason: Explains that paying in full changes interest, not merchant acceptance economics

scenes.narration: So cash back is real, but it sits inside a system funded across merchants and cardholders. Follow for more.

visual.visual_intent: A clean flow diagram connecting merchant, bank, and cardholder
visual.decision_reason: Synthesis of the verified card revenue loop
